ISLE

Guild Islands

Base building and guild facilities
6 island themes3 size tiersplots and buildings
Media slotGuild island layout exampleFuture screenshot for island layout, plots, buildings, or expedition UI.

Guild Island replaces the old Guildhall system. Each guild can build a home base with buildings, facilities, plots, and resources that support long-term guild progression.

Some prices can change between eras. Use the current in-game value if it differs from this guide.

How to Get an Island

  1. Send an Expedition

    Use the guild UI to search for an available Guild Island.

  2. First Claim

    The first expedition cannot fail and always returns a random small island.

  3. Progress Sizes

    To find a medium island, the guild must own a small island. To find a large island, the guild must own a medium island.

  4. Increase Expedition Limit

    Every guild starts with 1 expedition limit. This can be upgraded up to 5.

SGE

Guild Siege

Contested PvP bonuses
13 statues12 hour claim lockguild-wide bonuses
Media slotGuild siege statue or defense exampleFuture screenshot for siege statue, traps, defenses, or battlefield layout.

Guild Siege is the contested PvP guild system. After the 5th day from launch, players can enter through the Guild Siege plot inside their Guild Island. Siege access is available all day and is no longer only a Saturday event.

How Siege Works

  1. Build Access

    Guild Siege entrance is no longer through depot. It must be built as a plot on the Guild Island.

  2. Claim Statues

    Guilds claim statues for unique bonuses. Claimed statues cannot be claimed by another guild for 12 hours.

  3. Defense Window

    If a statue is stolen, the former owner has 15 minutes to claim it back before the new 12-hour timer starts.

  4. No Attacking Required

    To claim a statue, use it. The defending guild can only reclaim if no stealing guild member is within the marked area.

  5. 24 Hour Release

    After 24 hours of owning a Siege Statue, it releases and the former owner is blocked from reclaiming it for 12 hours.

Physical Defenses

DefenseDescription
BallistaDeals base damage every second to enemies within range. Damage and health scale with Siege Plot tier.

Fire TrapSpawns explosive barrels after being triggered. Damage scales with Siege Plot tier.
